[1] (ran5_cr_chunks 38.533, sim=0.6328)
Title: Introduction of TRS configurations and unified TCI state configurations Reason for change: For uTCI mTRP test cases, TS 38.133 introduced more types of TRS configurations and unified TCI state configurations, which are still not included in TS 38.533 Annex. Summary of change: Introduce TRS configurations and unified TCI state configurations to Annex. Consequences if not approved: The test parameters for uTCI mTRP would have no referrence. Clauses affected: A.1.4A.1.1, A.1.4A.1.2, A.10A.2

[2] (ran5_cr_chunks 38.521-2, sim=0.6271)
Title: Update TRP measurement procedure Annex in TS38.521-2 Reason for change: TRP measurement procedure have been updated in TR 38.810 v16.1.0. Annex L of TS 38.521-1 needs to be updated accordingly. Summary of change: Updated Annex L to be aligned with TR 38.810 v16.1.0 Consequences if not approved: TRP procedure will remain incomplete Clauses affected: Annex M

[3] (ran5_cr_chunks 38.905, sim=0.6174)
Reason for change: In TS 38.521-1, the minimum conformance requirements and test configurations of Reference Sensitivity test cases for FR1 NR CA have been cleaned-up. TP analysis in TR 38.905 is inconsistent with TS 38.521-1. Summary of change: Table 4.1.3.1-2 and Table 4.1.3.1-3 was updated according to TS 38.521-1 V19.3.0. Consequences if not approved: The inconsistency will remain. Clauses affected: 4.1.3.1

Title: Updates of TT in TS 38.521-2 Annex F during RAN5#81 Reason for change: TT (Test Tolerance) of TRx TCs was not completed. Summary of change: TT is updated based on agreement during RAN5#81. Consequences if not approved: TT values will be still imcompleted. Clauses affected: 6.2.1.1, 6.3.2, 6.4.1, 6.5.2.1, 6.5.2.3, 7.3.2, Annex F.3.2, F.3.3
